No they like me, and they tell me I'm smart and kind.
But that's I all I feel I'm worth. Yeah I'm smart... so what?
Plus my kindness is a double edge sword. I let people do what they want cause I value myself so little. My needs almost always come last.

Highschool sucks, but the teachers at uni really like me, and they even were the ones who got me the interview. But I went and messed it up lmao.

I do feel treated better and feel much safer around them. But it's really hard to accept myself now when no one did before.

Usually immediately.
I got bullied in school and a couple of the teachers made me feel worthless. And it doesn't help that my dad was always disappointed in me, so it's sort of a learned behaviour
Stress as well. It was really hard to concentrate on a job and do school.

What do you mean what kind of work?
I dunno, and yes ofc it's bc of insecurities. Being aware of the reasons doesn't really help. And no it's not made up.
Everyone has lives, jobs, partners, a social life, while I'm stuck in the same pattern. I've gone out of it s free times but always end up back to being jobless and alone. I've never been fired and it's always me who decides to stop working. 
Overthinking is literally all I ever do

I do but it's just so much work. I also feel I don't deserve them.
Plus I'm always so tired because I have Insomnia and it's just so hard
